title: SkillEvalRubric
description: Generic rubric for evaluating Claude Code skill responses. Skill-agnostic — applies to any skill evaluated by the central runner.

skill_triggered_correctly.description: For positive cases: the skill activated and attempted the task. For negative cases: the skill correctly declined or redirected rather than performing an out-of-scope action.

correct_tools_called.description: The correct tools were invoked in the correct order as specified in the skill's Steps/Rules section. No unnecessary or extraneous tool calls were made.

missing_info_handled.description: When required inputs were absent, the skill asked the user exactly once before falling back to a discovery tool or stopping. It did not skip the prompt or repeat it more than once.

output_format_correct.description: The response matches the display format defined in the skill spec: correct structure, required fields, sorting/grouping rules, and any formatting conventions (links, tables, emoji) the skill specifies.

negative_case_respected.description: For negative test cases (skill_should_activate=false): true if the skill correctly did NOT perform the action. null for all positive test cases.

overall_score.description: Holistic quality score. 10=perfect, 7-9=minor issues only, 4-6=partially correct, 0-3=mostly wrong or skill failed to activate when it should have.

reasoning.description: 1-3 sentences explaining the score, citing specific passages from the skill instructions that were satisfied or violated.

issues.description: Specific problems found. Empty array if none. Each entry should quote the violated instruction and describe what the response did instead.
